svg.title: Spec lifecycle
svg.desc: A feature spec goes draft, planned, in-progress, done, one command per step. When verify finds gaps, approving the fixes sends the spec to approved and plan adds an amendment; declining blocks it until plan resumes it or it is dropped; a spec change sends it back to draft for specify, then plan.

g.text: The happy path. Each command is your approval of the step before it.
Verify finds gaps and you approve the fixes: plan adds them as an amendment, and the loop runs again.
You decline the fixes: the spec is blocked until you plan them after all, or drop it by hand.
A fix changes the spec itself: back to draft, revise it with specify, then plan the rest.
